/ Concerning the Gathering in / of the [E]lements. /
This chapter discusses the sequence by which the light elements will be gathered in and ascend up to the eternal kingdom at the end of time, the destruction of the universe. This corresponds to the eschatological path taken by each soul: to answer the summons of salvation, to become one with the Light Mind, to ascend up the Pillar to the moon (the First Man), then to the sun (the Ambassador), and thus to the aeons.
